mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p2p_trades ( user_id, card_id, asset, quote_currency, status, total_buy_usdt, total_sell_usdt, total_buy_tnd, total_sell_tnd, total_binance_fee_usdt, total_binance_fee_tnd, total_other_fees_tnd, gross_profit_tnd, net_profit_tnd, notes, opened_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler}, #{cardId}, #{asset}, #{quoteCurrency}, #{status}, #{totalBuyUsdt}, #{totalSellUsdt}, #{totalBuyTnd}, #{totalSellTnd}, #{totalBinanceFeeUsdt}, #{totalBinanceFeeTnd}, #{totalOtherFeesTnd}, #{grossProfitTnd}, #{netProfitTnd}, #{notes}, #{openedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE p2p_trades SET total_buy_usdt = #{totalBuyUsdt}, total_sell_usdt = #{totalSellUsdt}, total_buy_tnd = #{totalBuyTnd}, total_sell_tnd = #{totalSellTnd}, total_binance_fee_usdt = #{totalBinanceFeeUsdt}, total_binance_fee_tnd = #{totalBinanceFeeTnd}, gross_profit_tnd = #{grossProfitTnd}, net_profit_tnd = #{netProfitTnd}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
